timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This is Dr Abraham Vice-Feld reporting for the Struggle Cable TV News.
I'm here, present with Miyasara Tiani, who is the spokesperson for the Prisoner Support Committee of the General Palestinian Women's Union here in Palestine.
And we're talking about the current state of the Palestinian Prisoner's Hunger Strike, which has not entered into even negotiations with the occupying force.
So, what is the current condition of the solidarity movement with the Palestinian prisoners who continue now into their 38th day of the Hunger Strike?
We are now in Nablus, Rizuna Abistain, with the family of the Rizuna.
Until now, as you said, there is no negotiation between the occupation and the Rizuna Abistain, and they are going on in their hunger strike.
What I want to tell all the world, that our war, our battle, not just with the soldiers, but with the Rizuna Abistain, and outside, it is a battle with the State of the Rizuna Abistain.

Why? Because while we were in Nablus, we met with military force at a war at Shikboi, a citylar killed civilian, a protestor called Muataz, 22 years from beta, where I was present with the people, the families of the Rizuna Abistain.
So, the citylar used their guns, their weapons, and killed the civilian people in the demonstration, in the marches, in the cities and the villages.
So, what we need, we need to be protected by you and these people, we need the international, the international court against the tourists of the occupation.

Our message, I am very emotional, I am with all the Rizuna Abistain, at their battle with the families here at the 10th, our message, this is our land, this is Palestine, not the citylar's land, our political Rizuna Abistain, who must have their freedom, they must have to be free.
So, our message, we will not give up, we will go on our struggle until they will be free, until Palestine will be free.
